bestBets.overview: The week begins with an eight race Tuncurry card. 30mm of rain over the week leading to Saturday. Track rated Soft 7 at that time but we are expecting a little more (1-5mm) rain on Sunday so we'll lock in at least a Soft. It's a 7 on race morning in fact and we move on from there. We start with a mile C1/Maiden and we are back to just six to compete. PELOSA should be able to find a handier position rising to the mile 3rd-up and this looks her best chance yet of breaking through for the stable. This feels similar to last start for THE COMANCHE and - on race morning anyway - he faces the prospect of starting favourite for the first time in his career.

raceTips.comment: The Comanche maps well and looks suitable placed in a field of this calibre to notch up another win. Pelosa is ready to peak third up and looks well placed rising is distance and dropping in grade. Creative Righteous did enough for a new trainer last start and looks a lock to fight out the minor money spoils. Cannystep next.

bestBets.overview: Pace from 3, 6, 8 and 2. LOVE YOU ANYWAY lines up for start 22 so clearly the 7YO mare has had a bagful of chances before today. She's managed to pull in $70,000 prizemoney along the way. DREAM A LITTLE has come back placing twice and been big odds both times. Surely no $41 available here. POMELO CHAMOMILE has trialed OK - got well back and reasonable in the latest - and should stalk to perfection. COSMIC JIVE well backed on debut now needs to really lift it up.

raceTips.comment: Dream A Little appeals at odds post freshen after recent form lines has subsequently stacked up well. Has a tricky draw to contend with, but with even luck can run much better than odds suggest. Pomelo Chamomile has already been subject to early market support and sets up for a soft run from a low draw. Love You Anyway backs up quickly after having found the line well last start. Chances are running out however. Cosmic Jive will have derived benefit from a debut run and has scope to improve.

Her overall form recommends her though and there's winning form out of the Gosford race on July 9th. THE WARRIOR (another Newcastle entrant) could be tempted to cross on-pace perhaps, albeit he mostly has done that at longer trips.

raceTips.comment: Triple Yes didn't gain a start as emergency over the weekend so lines up here which looks like the better option. The Warrior didn't have luck at a crucial time last start but found the line well. Miss Trump was well supported and had the right run to justify the quote first up. Has plenty of upside.

MOSGIEL CRYSTAL was arguably unlucky to lose last start; she just couldn't really ever find clear running all down the straight. Can see her finding a much cuter run from this barrier and amends can be made pretty quickly. DAMASCUS GATE can lead the way and still seems to be ticking along well in what is now a very lengthy preparation.

raceTips.comment: Mosgiel Crystal was luckless in running last time out and arguably should have won the race. Happy to stick with her so she can atone. Whiskers comes via the same race and didn't seem to finish off but strips fitter third up and can improve sharply. Damascus Gate was eating into the winning margin late last start and will have fans on that effort. Explosive Tycoon next.

bestBets.overview: Pace from 6 ahead of 11 and 13. CRESTA RUN is one of those at the front end and looks just about ready to get a win this prep. Narrowly beaten on Soft 7 1st-up but her overall record suggests Heavy could be her issue perhaps. That's mostly because she has never attempted it before. COOL FIZZ has finished top two more often than not and has some positive form at the venue as well.

raceTips.comment: Cresta Run was good last time beating all bar an odds on favourite. Peaking now, this is a perfect piece of placement. Grassburn strips fitter from a sound first up effort and sets up as the map horse of the race. Altercation has to overcome a tricky draw but comes off a last start win that will see her have her fans. The Piccolino next.
